αὐχένος: αὐχήν — neck, nape; masc. gen. sg., after διά: ’through the neck’
βάλον: βάλλω — throw, cast, put; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔβαλον) · also aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending): ’I struck’
βαλών: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., unaugmented: ’having thrown’
βαλὼν: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck, striking’
γιγνώσκων: γιγνώσκω — come to know, perceive, recognise; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’realising, being aware’
γούνατ: γόνυ (pl. γούνατα) — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided (γούνατ’ = γούνατα)
γόον: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. acc. sg.
δίδου: δίδωμι — give; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’give!’ · also impf. 3 sg., epic (= ἐδίδου): ’she gave’ (of the Muse)
δαΐφρονι: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. dat. sg.
δαμάσσῃ: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic δαμάσῃ), in a fear clause after μή: ’lest it overpower’
διζήμενος: δίζημαι — seek, search for; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’seeking’
δόμοις: δόμος — house; masc. dat. pl.: ’in houses’ (ἐν postponed, with anastrophe) · also plural for a single house, after ἐν: ἐν Ἀτρεΐδαο δόμοις ’in the house of Atreus’ son’
εἰλήλουθα: ἔρχομαι — come, go; redupl. perf. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθα): ’I have come’
εἰποῦσ: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (εἰποῦσ’ = εἰποῦσα)
εἰσορόων: εἰσοράω — look upon, gaze at; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶν)
θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., genitive with a verb of hearing · also genitive governed by a preposition (ἄνευ θεοῦ ’without a god’) · also possessive genitive with a noun: ’of the god’ (θεοῦ δαῖτα) · also gen. with ἄρχομαι, ’from the god’ (the point of departure) · also masc. gen. sg. used of a goddess (the masc. form serves either sex): θεοῦ εὐνήν ’a goddess’s bed’ · also predicate genitive of possession: ’belonging to a god’ (δεινοῦ γὰρ θεοῦ αἵδε βόες ’these cattle are a dread god’s’)
κέχυνται: χέω — pour; pass. be poured out, lie scattered; perf. mid./pass. 3 pl.: ’lie scattered’
κήδεα: κῆδος — care, trouble, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήδη)
καλοὶ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. nom. pl., agreeing with χοροί
κοτεσσάμενος: κοτέω — bear a grudge, be angry; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken offense, bearing a grudge’
κρῖ: κρῖ — barley (indeclinable form of κριθή); neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (indeclinable, same form), subject of an existential clause: κρῖ λευκόν ’white barley’ (understood ἔνι ’is in it’)
κτεάτεσσι: κτέαρ — possession, property (mostly pl.); neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κτήμασι)
κτῆσιν: κτῆσις — possessions, property; fem. acc. sg.
λιπέσθαι: λείπω — leave; aor. mid. inf. λιπέσθαι: ’to be left behind’ (παῖδα λιπέσθαι ’that a son be left behind’)
λυγρῷ: λυγρός — baneful, bitter, grievous; masc./neut. dat. sg.
μίγη: μίγνυμι — mix, unite; aor. pass. (sense mid.) 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμίγη): ’was united (with), lay (with)’ + dat.
μαίνεται: μαίνομαι — rage, be frenzied; pres. 3 sg. mid.
μετῴχετο: μετοίχομαι — go after, go about among; impf. 3 sg.
νεφέλῃ: νεφέλη — cloud; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’in cloud’
νώτου: νῶτον — back, chine (of an animal); gen. sg., partitive after a verb of cutting: ’from the chine’
οἶδ: οἶδα — know; perf. 1 sg., elided (οἶδ’ = οἶδα) · also perf. 3 sg. (identical elided form): ’he/she knows’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ(ε) ’who knows’)
πέπλοι: πέπλος — cloth, coverlet, robe; masc. nom. pl.
πίσυνος: πίσυνος — trusting, relying on (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg.
παρέασι: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic πάρεισι)
πατρίδ: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; fem. acc. sg., elided (πατρίδ’ = πατρίδα)
πειρώμενος: πειράω (mid. πειράομαι) — try, test; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’testing’
πιθόμην: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι, obey, heed (+ dat.); aor. 2 mid. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπιθόμην)
ποιμὴν: ποιμήν — shepherd, herdsman; masc. nom. sg.
ποῦ: ποῦ — where?; interrog. adv., here in indirect use: ’where’ · also in a direct question: ’where?’ (ποῦ δέ μιν εὗρε; ’and where did she find him?’)
σταθμοὺς: σταθμός — farmstead, steading; masc. acc. pl. · also σταθμός — door-post; masc. acc. pl.: ἐν δὲ σταθμοὺς ἄρσε ’fitted door-posts in’
στὰς: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stood, standing’
τάμοι: τέμνω — cut; aor. opt. 3 sg., epic strong aor. (= Attic τέμοι)
τείρετο: τείρω — wear out, distress; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτείρετο): ’was worn down’
τούτου: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. gen. sg.
τῷδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. dat. sg., elided (τῷδ’ = τῷδε)
φθάμενος: φθάνω — come first, forestall; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic φθάς): ’forestalling’
χαλεπὴ: χαλεπός — hard, grievous; fem. nom. sg., with μοῖρα
ἀγκύλα: ἀγκύλος — curved, bent; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with τόξα
ἀγρῷ: ἀγρός — field, countryside; masc. dat. sg., locative: ’in the country’
ἀλλότριος: ἀλλότριος — of another, foreign, strange; masc. nom. sg.
ἀνασχὼν: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., grave accent (mid-clause): ’having raised’
ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)
ἀτρεκὲς: ἀτρεκής — exact, precise; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’exactly’
ἀχλὺν: ἀχλύς — mist, darkness; fem. acc. sg.
ἄλοχόν: ἄλοχος — wife, spouse; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
ἄνευθε: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart from, without; prep. + gen., epic (= Attic ἄνευ) · also adv., no case governed: ’apart, at a distance’ (αἱ δ’ ἄνευθε ’they lie apart’)
ἐκέλευε: κελεύω — bid, command, urge; impf. 3 sg.: ’kept bidding’
ἐκρίνατ: κρίνω — pick out, choose, select; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ἐκρίνατο → ἐκρίνατ’)
ἐμίχθη: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was mingled’
ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
ἐξέρυσ: ἐξερύω — draw out, pull out; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἐξέρυσ’ = ἐξέρυσε)
ἐξαίνυτο: ἐξαίνυμαι — take out, take away; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’took out’
ἐπιβαίην: ἐπιβαίνω — set foot on, board, embark upon; aor. opt. 1 sg., potential with ἄν, + gen.: ’I would set foot on’
ἐπῆεν: ἔπειμι (εἰμί) — be upon, be on it; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἐπῆν)
ἐρχομένῳ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg.: ’(to him) going’
ἐσθλῶν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, excellent; masc. gen. pl. · also neut. gen. pl., of things: ’of good things’ (ἐσθλῶν ἠδὲ κακῶν ’of good things and bad’)
ἑνὶ: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc./neut. dat. sg. ἑνί
ἔασ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., epic ἔασι (= Attic εἰσί), elided
ἠρᾶτο: ἀράομαι — pray, vow; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ἀ- → ἠ-)
ἤγειρα: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. 1 sg. act.: ’I gathered’
ἧκα: ἵημι — send, let go; aor. 1 sg. (κ-aorist): ’I let go’
ἱρῶν: ἱερός (Ionic ἱρός) — sacred, holy; neut. gen. pl.: ’of the sacred rites’
ὀπηδεῖ: ὀπηδέω — accompany, attend (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.: ’keeps company with’
ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ὄψεσθαι: ὁράω — see; fut. inf. mid. (ὄψομαι), after ἐφάμην
ὕπερθεν: ὕπερθεν — above, from above, on top; adv.
